title: hive.agent-action-timestamp/1
description: One RFC 3161 timestamp token over a record head. The token's message imprint is SHA-256 with the head's 32 bytes as the hashed message.

count.description: Number of lines covered. The head is the hash of line count-1.

tsa.description: The timestamp authority that issued the token.

token.description: DER TimeStampResp as returned by the authority.
